en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a wide street lined with trees and ornate late‑19th‑century villas or townhouses. In the foreground at right stands an elaborate multi‑arm street lamp. The main building complex on the left has steep roofs, turrets, and decorative gables, surrounded by a fence and small garden. Printed red text appears along the bottom margin identifying the location and publisher, along with a date.
